// DefaultBuilder - passes through values as-is
type DefaultBuilder[T any] struct {
	Hook func(*T) T
}

func NewDefaultBuilder[T any]() *DefaultBuilder[T] {
	return &DefaultBuilder[T]{
		Hook: nil,
	}
}

func (b *DefaultBuilder[T]) Build(data json.RawMessage) (T, error) {
	var result T

	// First try direct unmarshaling (handles numeric values)
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &result); err != nil {
		// If direct unmarshaling fails, try parsing as string and convert
		var strValue string
		if strErr := json.Unmarshal(data, &strValue); strErr != nil {
			return result, err // Return original error if both attempts fail
		}

		// Convert string to target type using type assertion
		if converted, ok := parseStringToType[T](strValue); ok {
			result = converted
		} else {
			return result, err
		}
	}

	if b.Hook != nil {
		return b.Hook(&result), nil
	}
	return result, nil
}

// Generic string parser function
func parseStringToType[T any](str string) (T, bool) {
	var zero T
	switch any(zero).(type) {
	case uint32:
		if val, err := strconv.ParseUint(str, 10, 32); err == nil {
			return any(uint32(val)).(T), true
		}
	case uint16:
		if val, err := strconv.ParseUint(str, 10, 16); err == nil {
			return any(uint16(val)).(T), true
		}
	case uint8:
		if val, err := strconv.ParseUint(str, 10, 8); err == nil {
			return any(uint8(val)).(T), true
		}
	case int:
		if val, err := strconv.Atoi(str); err == nil {
			return any(val).(T), true
		}
	case int32:
		if val, err := strconv.ParseInt(str, 10, 32); err == nil {
			return any(int32(val)).(T), true
		}
	case int64:
		if val, err := strconv.ParseInt(str, 10, 64); err == nil {
			return any(val).(T), true
		}
	}
	return zero, false
}

// ArrayBuilder - builds arrays/slices
type ArrayBuilder[T any] struct {
	elementBuilder func(json.RawMessage) (T, error)
	Hook           func(*[]T) []T
}

func NewArrayBuilder[T any](elementBuilder func(json.RawMessage) (T, error)) *ArrayBuilder[T] {
	return &ArrayBuilder[T]{elementBuilder: elementBuilder, Hook: nil}
}

func (b *ArrayBuilder[T]) Build(data json.RawMessage) ([]T, error) {
	var rawArray []json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &rawArray); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	result := make([]T, len(rawArray))
	for i, rawElement := range rawArray {
		element, err := b.elementBuilder(rawElement)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result[i] = element
	}

	if b.Hook != nil {
		return b.Hook(&result), nil
	}
	return result, nil
}

// DictionaryBuilder - builds maps
type DictionaryBuilder[K comparable, V any] struct {
	keyBuilder   func(json.RawMessage) (K, error)
	valueBuilder func(json.RawMessage) (V, error)
	Hook         func(*map[K]V) map[K]V
}

func NewDictionaryBuilder[K comparable, V any](keyBuilder func(json.RawMessage) (K, error), valueBuilder func(json.RawMessage) (V, error)) *DictionaryBuilder[K, V] {
	return &DictionaryBuilder[K, V]{
		keyBuilder:   keyBuilder,
		valueBuilder: valueBuilder,
		Hook:         nil,
	}
}

func (b *DictionaryBuilder[K, V]) Build(data json.RawMessage) (map[K]V, error) {
	var rawMap map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &rawMap); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	result := make(map[K]V)
	for rawKey, rawValue := range rawMap {
		// Convert string key to target type K
		keyData, _ := json.Marshal(rawKey)
		key, err := b.keyBuilder(keyData)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		value, err := b.valueBuilder(rawValue)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		result[key] = value
	}

	if b.Hook != nil {
		return b.Hook(&result), nil
	}
	return result, nil
}

// EnumBuilder - converts string enum values to their numeric equivalents
type EnumBuilder[T any] struct {
	nameToValue map[string]T
	Hook        func(*T) T
}

func NewEnumBuilder[T any](nameToValue map[string]T) *EnumBuilder[T] {
	return &EnumBuilder[T]{
		nameToValue: nameToValue,
		Hook:        nil,
	}
}

func (b *EnumBuilder[T]) Build(data json.RawMessage) (T, error) {
	var result T

	// Try to unmarshal as string first (enum name)
	var enumName string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &enumName); err == nil {
		if value, exists := b.nameToValue[enumName]; exists {
			result = value
		} else {
			// If enum name not found, try to parse as number
			if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &result); err != nil {
				return result, fmt.Errorf("unknown enum value: %s", enumName)
			}
		}
	} else {
		// Try to unmarshal as number
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &result); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
	}

	if b.Hook != nil {
		return b.Hook(&result), nil
	}
	return result, nil
}

// TimeSpanBuilder - builds Duration from time span strings
type TimeSpanBuilder struct {
	Hook func(*Duration) Duration
}

func NewTimeSpanBuilder() *TimeSpanBuilder {
	return &TimeSpanBuilder{Hook: nil}
}

func (b *TimeSpanBuilder) Build(data json.RawMessage) (Duration, error) {
	var raw string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}

	if raw == "" {
		return 0, nil
	}

	// Parse time span format: [days.]hours:minutes:seconds
	re := regexp.MustCompile(`(?:(?P<day>\d+)[\s\.])?(?P<hour>\d+):(?P<min>\d+):(?P<sec>\d+)`)
	matches := re.FindStringSubmatch(raw)
	if matches == nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid time format: %s", raw)
	}

	var days, hours, minutes, seconds int
	var err error

	for i, name := range re.SubexpNames() {
		if i == 0 {
			continue
		}
		value := matches[i]
		if value == "" {
			continue
		}

		switch name {
		case "day":
			days, err = strconv.Atoi(value)
		case "hour":
			hours, err = strconv.Atoi(value)
		case "min":
			minutes, err = strconv.Atoi(value)
		case "sec":
			seconds, err = strconv.Atoi(value)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
	}

	totalSeconds := seconds + minutes*60 + hours*3600 + days*86400
	result := Duration(time.Duration(totalSeconds) * time.Second)

	if b.Hook != nil {
		return b.Hook(&result), nil
	}
	return result, nil
}

// DateTimeBuilder - builds time.Time from datetime strings
type DateTimeBuilder struct {
	Hook func(*time.Time) time.Time
}

func NewDateTimeBuilder() *DateTimeBuilder {
	return &DateTimeBuilder{Hook: nil}
}

func (b *DateTimeBuilder) Build(data json.RawMessage) (time.Time, error) {
	var raw string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
		return time.Time{}, err
	}

	if raw == "" {
		return time.Time{}, nil
	}

	result, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02 15:04:05", raw)
	if err != nil {
		return time.Time{}, err
	}

	if b.Hook != nil {
		return b.Hook(&result), nil
	}
	return result, nil
}

// DateRangeBuilder - builds DateRange structures
type DateRangeBuilder struct {
	Hook func(*DateRange) DateRange
}

func NewDateRangeBuilder() *DateRangeBuilder {
	return &DateRangeBuilder{Hook: nil}
}

func (b *DateRangeBuilder) Build(data json.RawMessage) (DateRange, error) {
	var raw struct {
		Start json.RawMessage `json:"Start"`
		End   json.RawMessage `json:"End"`
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
		return DateRange{}, err
	}

	result := DateRange{}
	begin, err := NewDateTimeBuilder().Build(raw.Start)
	if err != nil {
		return DateRange{}, err
	}
	result.Begin = begin

	end, err := NewDateTimeBuilder().Build(raw.End)
	if err != nil {
		return DateRange{}, err
	}
	result.End = end

	if b.Hook != nil {
		return b.Hook(&result), nil
	}
	return result, nil
}

// DslBuilder - builds DSL structures
type DslBuilder struct {
	Hook func(*Dsl) Dsl
}

func NewDslBuilder() *DslBuilder {
	return &DslBuilder{Hook: nil}
}

func (b *DslBuilder) Build(data json.RawMessage) (Dsl, error) {
	var rawDsl struct {
		Header string            `json:"Header"`
		Params []json.RawMessage `json:"Params"`
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &rawDsl); err != nil {
		return Dsl{}, err
	}

	// Convert string type to DSL enum
	dslType := DSL_ITEM // default
	if typeValue, exists := dsl_name_to_value[strings.ToLower(rawDsl.Header)]; exists {
		dslType = typeValue
	}

	// Convert parameters from RawMessage to []any
	params := make([]any, len(rawDsl.Params))
	for i, param := range rawDsl.Params {
		var value any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(param, &value); err != nil {
			return Dsl{}, err
		}
		params[i] = value
	}

	result := Dsl{Header: dslType, Params: params}

	if b.Hook != nil {
		return b.Hook(&result), nil
	}
	return result, nil
}
